row_semantics: Each row represents a specific direction light error status subscription interface for different instances (left or right turn signals).

core_entities.name: DirectionLightErrorStatus
core_entities.description: Service interface to subscribe to the error status of direction lights.

core_entities.name: InstanceID
core_entities.description: Unique identifier for each instance of the direction light error status subscription. InstanceID=1 for left turn signal, InstanceID=2 for right turn signal.

core_entities.name: DirectionLightErrorSta
core_entities.description: Parameter name for the direction light error status.

core_outputs.name: HardLineFaultStatus
core_outputs.description: Indicates the hard line fault status of the subscribed direction light.

core_faults.name: No Error
core_faults.description: No error detected in the direction light.

core_faults.name: Error
core_faults.description: An error has been detected in the direction light.

core_faults.name: Unknown
core_faults.description: The status of the direction light is unknown.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the service interfaces for subscribing to the error status of left and right front turn signals, including the parameter names, instance IDs, and possible error states.
